title: Centre–State relations in India embody a cooperative, quasi-federal structure with a strong unitary bias

content.overview: Centre–State relations in India embody a cooperative, quasi-federal structure with a strong unitary bias. Governed by Part XI (Legislative and Administrative Relations, Arts 245–263) and Part XII (Financial Relations, Arts 264–293), anchored by the Seventh Schedule, Article 254 (Repugnancy), and basic structure federalism.
